items.question: How accurate is the contract analysis?
items.answer: The AI model has been trained on legal precedents and statutory data, detecting all potentially suspicious risks. However, we recommend consulting a qualified attorney for final legal judgment.

items.question: Are the uploaded contracts secure?
items.answer: All documents are permanently deleted immediately after analysis. Your personal information and contract contents are strictly protected.

items.question: Can I download the analysis results?
items.answer: Yes. Once the analysis is complete, you can download the results in HTML format, including the number of issues found, which laws are violated, and recommendations.

article1.title: Article 1 (Purpose of Collection and Use of Personal Information)
article1.content: The Company processes personal information for the following purposes. The personal information being processed will not be used for purposes other than the following, and if the purpose of use changes, necessary measures will be implemented, such as obtaining separate consent in accordance with the Personal Information Protection Act.
article1.item1: Membership registration and management: Confirmation of intention to join, provision of membership services, identification and authentication
article1.item2: Service provision: Provision of contract analysis services, content provision, customized service provision
article1.item3: Marketing and advertising: Development of new services and provision of customized services, provision of event information and advertising information

article2.title: Article 2 (Items of Personal Information Collected)
article2.content: The Company collects the following personal information to provide services.
article2.requiredItem3: Service usage records, access logs, cookies, access IP information
article2.optionalItem1: Name, contact information (when applying for consultation)

article3.title: Article 3 (Retention and Use Period of Personal Information)
article3.content: In principle, the Company destroys the information without delay after the purpose of collection and use of personal information is achieved. However, the following information is retained for the period specified below for the reasons stated.
article3.item1: Upon membership withdrawal: Immediate deletion upon withdrawal
article3.item2: Retention according to relevant laws: Retained for a certain period according to relevant laws such as the E-Commerce Act and the Communications Secrets Protection Act
article3.item3: Contract analysis data: Immediately encrypted and destroyed after analysis completion

article4.title: Article 4 (Provision of Personal Information to Third Parties)
article4.content: In principle, the Company processes users' personal information within the scope specified in Article 1 and does not process beyond the original scope or provide it to third parties without the user's prior consent. However, exceptions are made in the following cases.
article4.item1: When the user has consented in advance
article4.item2: When required by investigative agencies according to procedures and methods defined by law for investigation purposes

article5.title: Article 5 (Procedures and Methods for Destroying Personal Information)
article5.content: In principle, the Company destroys personal information without delay when the purpose of processing personal information is achieved.
article5.procedureDesc: Information entered by users is transferred to a separate DB after the purpose is achieved (separate documents in case of paper) and stored for a certain period according to internal policies and other relevant laws, or destroyed immediately.
article5.methodItem1: Electronic file format: Permanently deleted in an unrecoverable manner

article6.title: Article 6 (Rights and Obligations of Data Subjects and Methods of Exercise)
article6.content: Users can exercise the following rights as personal information subjects.
article6.item2: Request correction in case of errors

article7.title: Article 7 (Personal Information Protection Officer)
article7.content: The Company designates a Personal Information Protection Officer as follows to oversee personal information processing and to handle complaints and remedy damages related to personal information processing.
article7.name: Name

article8.title: Article 8 (Changes to Privacy Policy)
article8.content: This privacy policy is applied from the effective date, and if there are additions, deletions, or corrections to changes according to laws and policies, they will be announced through notices 7 days before the implementation of the changes.
